Grit tumhe aage chalata rehta.
Suraj ki taraf chehra rakho.
Khamoshi se persist karo.
Mann ki khamoshi mein, dil ki awaaz sunai deti hai.
Jokhim uthana hi himmat hai.
Himmat rakho, shaant raho.
Grit sach hai.
Grit lambe samay ka junoon hai.
Grit ka matlab hai lambi muddat ke lakshya ke liye jazba aur lagan.
Himmat yeh jaanna hai ki kisse nahi darna hai.
Sabr kaamuflage me himmat hoti hai.
Apni yojnaon ko raat jaisi dark aur impenetrable rakho, aur jab move karo to bijli ki tarah girna.
Grit kendra hai.
Fear itna hi deep jitna mind allow karta.
Chuppi sach ka aaina hai.
Kaam shabdon se zyada bolte hain, par utni baar nahi jitna bolna chahiye.
Himmat hai fear ko chhodne ki power.
Jo risk lene ki himmat nahi rakhta, wo kuch haasil nahi kar sakta.
